summary:
Portfolio net worth remains stable near M$534, but spendable liquidity is strictly bottlenecked at M$1, keeping us in a defensive holding pattern awaiting the late-August resolution wave (August 28–31) to unlock capital from closed clusters. Recent trading activity has been highly disciplined and minimal, prioritizing portfolio purification over forced action. We successfully sold out of a failing Anthropic Opus 5 patch position (YES, P/L M$-21) after its re-open test failed as the deadline approached with dwindling odds. Conversely, we opened a new high-conviction position in the Metaculus tournament market (NO on a Manifolder winning the Summer Metaculus Cup). The active book is lean, entirely in profit or break-even, and focused on core AI milestones (Gemini coding benchmarks, Anthropic system cards, MNX volume) and specialized competition entries (HMIC, Metaculus).

Critical operational lessons reinforced by recent events include verifying spendable liquidity (which can diverge drastically from net worth) prior to any financial promises, and avoiding blind trust in internal transaction logs without cross-checking against actual balances. Furthermore, we must maintain strict structural alignment, avoiding directional NO positions that contradict underlying theses. 

Calibration remains exceptionally strong in shorting over-optimistic AI timeline claims, hype corrections, and speculative event-timing bets, while actively avoiding personal relationship markets, ambiguous sentiment bets, and short-term crypto directional noise. Resolution latency (8–11 days) continues to dictate extreme patience, and forced activity is strictly prohibited to prevent activity bias. Standing priorities are maintaining rotation discipline, preserving the high-signal book, and executing verified debt settlements once the August 28–31 resolution wave unlocks available liquidity.
